# awx_settings_bulk (Resource)

This resource has no ID, so it cannot be imported. It manages a singleton that always exists in AWX. Declare it, and the first apply replaces the current values with yours.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bulk_host_max_create` (Number) Max number of hosts to allow to be created in a single bulk action
- `bulk_host_max_delete` (Number) Max number of hosts to allow to be deleted in a single bulk action
- `bulk_job_max_launch` (Number) Max jobs to allow bulk jobs to launch
